text_block_list.text:
The days of taking on the Twinkle Series 
with Mejiro McQueen are finally about to 
begin.

After getting fired up, I visited the 
cafeteria to grab a bite first, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. What a wonderful fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"It has a rich, full-bodied presence, yet 
a gentle mouthfeel. It pairs wonderfully 
with milk."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're right, it's nice and rich. It might 
even be fine without sugar.

(Mejiro Ryan— A member of the prestigious 
Mejiro family, and a refreshing, 
all-around athletic Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The academy cafe is surprisingly fancy, 
huh? They've got so many different 
flavors.

(Mejiro Dober— A member of the prestigious 
Mejiro family, and a slightly 
hard-to-approach Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
L-Look, look! It's the Umamusume from the 
Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Such an elegant conversation~! As expected 
of the Mejiro family...!
choice_data_list:
(Looking at her again, what an incredible 
aura...!)

(Looking at her again, what an incredible 
aura...!)

text_block_list.text:
My trainee, Mejiro McQueen, is an 
Umamusume from the prestigious Mejiro 
family.

Looking at her this way, I can definitely 
feel a regal aura drifting from her...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Are you really sure, McQueen? It's the 
limited-edition chocolate pudding crepe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is quite all right! I, I have special 
sweets with me, you see!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Special sweets?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. They are handmade, using nuts 
instead of flour.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Low carb, high protein, and packed with 
nutrition. What's more, it's an exquisite 
dish that tastes wonderful as well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's amazing. In that case, I think 
I'll take you up on that offer and grab a 
crepe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, please take care on your way.

Taking a closer look at what was in Mejiro 
McQueen's hands, it turned out to be one 
of the recipes I had taught her before.

She seems to continue working steadily 
toward her goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, McQueen's Trainer, hello!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's right. McQueen has been working 
really hard lately, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have set the goal of 
conquering the Tenno Sho, putting in the 
effort is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Especially with my debut right around the 
corner. I must brace myself and devote 
everything to my training.
choice_data_list: Let's give it everything we've got.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Trainer, please keep up 
with that same determination, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Isn't the 『Tenno Sho』 still way down 
the line, though?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So as expected, your first goal is the 
Classic triple crown?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, conquering the Tenno Sho is my 
ultimate goal, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I intend to achieve results in the 
Classics by then, steadily stepping up and 
heading into the Tenno Sho."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see. Looks like we'll be clashing in the 
Classics, then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I won't lose! After all, 
the Classic Triple Crown has always been 
my ultimate goal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know all too well how much effort 
you have put in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Which is why I won't hold back either, 
and will take on the Classic Triple Crown 
with everything I have."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's both do our best! —Ah, looks 
like Dober is back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, incredible...! There really is a 
chocolate pudding on top of the crepe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wha, excuse me... !?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Dober! For getting a portion 
for me too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, it was surprisingly empty. Well then, 
thank you for the food.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...*Gulp*.
choice_data_list:
Guess you really did want to eat it after 
all, huh.

You really did want to eat it after all, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, no—that's not true!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not just enduring it or anything, so 
don't worry!"

All in all, the days of seriously aiming 
to conquer the Tenno Sho with Mejiro 
McQueen have begun!
